item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Since this thread was on page 6 of the forum listing with no responses, this is a quick staff reminder to the author that if you haven't yet, you should contact reviewers directly to request feedback as needed.

Please refer to this thread for more information: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

If you have already reached out to multiple reviewers and received no reply, notify a staff member for assistance finding a reviewer.

item.title: An SCP idea (Seeking greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): It has a letter requesting a full data release of SCP-XXXX, this request is denied, other than that it is standard although there is a test log.

Elevator Pitch:
SCP-XXXX is a small dot with a gravitational pull around it, anything to enter said gravitational pull will be drawn into an alternate reality.

Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX draws anything inside the gravitational pull of it into an alternate reality consisting of several large flat planes of land that are constantly moving. The way out is a blue sphere of gel 1 meter in diameter.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: SCP-XXXX is different from other SCPs because it is an alternate reality full of essentially big flat moving chunks of land. Also in the test long subject D-[REDACTED] just, disappears. Two Class-D were sent in, but only one returned.

Additional Notes:
